title: 1997 Topps #492 Prospects RC Jimmy Anderson Ron Blazier Gerald Witasick Jr.
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
1997 Topps #492 Prospects rookie card: Jimmy Anderson (Pittsburgh Pirates), Ron Blazier (Philadelphia Phillies) and Gerald Witasick Jr. (Oakland Athletics). Marked ROOKIE CARD on the back for all three.

Ships in an eBay Standard Envelope.
